block.hallowed.carved_pumpkin.desc: Shears carve a new face (sneak for the last one). A torch lights it.
block.hallowed.cursed_pumpkin.dormant: It whispers of midnight. Only the Witching Hour will wake it.
block.hallowed.cursed_pumpkin.nowhere: Nothing rides here. It needs a sky and a night.
block.hallowed.cursed_pumpkin.peaceful: Nothing answers. The world is too peaceful.
block.hallowed.cursed_pumpkin.waking: It is waking. Something is coming for it.
commands.hallowed.witching: The Witching Hour is moments away.
event.hallowed.dawn: Dawn breaks. The Hallowed Night is over.
item.hallowed.bat_wing_licorice.desc: Night Vision, and every monster nearby lights up like a lantern.
item.hallowed.candy_corn.desc: A quick handful: Sugar Rush that stacks.
item.hallowed.caramel_apple.desc: Regeneration, a golden coat of Absorption and a little Sugar Rush.
item.hallowed.eyeball_jawbreaker.desc: Takes a while to get through. Worth it: Strength.
item.hallowed.ghost_gummy.desc: You go pale, then see-through: Invisibility and Slow Falling.
item.hallowed.horseman_head.desc: Still burning. Worn: Night Vision, and spirits leave you be.
item.hallowed.pumpkin_truffle.desc: Warm and steady: cures Spooked and Sugar Crash, then Resistance and Fire Resistance.
item.hallowed.reaper_scythe.desc: Use to Reap: cut everything around you and harvest ripe crops.
item.hallowed.soul_toffee.desc: Spirit Ward: spirits take you for one of their own.
item.hallowed.treat_pail.desc: Hold it out to a villager on a Hallowed Night. Holds candy only.
item.hallowed.witch_lollipop.desc: Every lick a hex. Usually a good one.
trick.hallowed.already: They have already answered the door tonight.
trick.hallowed.not_tonight: They peer out at you, puzzled. Come back on a Hallowed Night.
trick.hallowed.pail_full: Your Treat Pail is full; the rest went to your pockets.
trick.hallowed.treat.costume: Treat! %s pieces of candy, for a fine costume.
